office.label: Downtown Nashville
office.oneLineDistinction: Office, hospitality and entertainment in the urban core
office.shortDescription: Downtown Nashville brings together offices, government, hospitality, convention activity and entertainment within the city’s central street grid. Its business core operates alongside Lower Broadway’s visitor economy, making it distinct from Music Row’s specialized industry cluster and MetroCenter’s campus-like setting.
whatStandsOut: Office, hospitality and entertainment in the urban core
worthKnowing: Confirm the exact block, building format and current space conditions.

office.label: Music Row / Midtown
office.oneLineDistinction: Music-business offices in a specialized creative district
office.shortDescription: Music Row and Midtown center on Nashville’s music-business ecosystem, with offices, studios, institutions, hotels and mixed-use buildings between Downtown and Vanderbilt. The concentration of music-industry work gives it a commercial identity that broader downtown office language cannot explain.
whatStandsOut: Music-business offices in a specialized creative district
worthKnowing: Confirm the exact block, building format and current space conditions.

retail.label: The Gulch
retail.shortDescription: The Gulch is a compact, newer mixed-use district immediately southwest of Downtown, with restaurants, shops, hotels, offices and residential towers arranged around former rail land. Its contemporary building stock and walkable concentration differ from 12 South’s low-rise neighborhood corridor.
worthKnowing: Confirm the exact block, building format and current space conditions.

retail.label: 12 South
retail.oneLineDistinction: Neighborhood shops and dining along 12th Avenue
retail.shortDescription: 12 South follows 12th Avenue South as a low-rise neighborhood shopping and dining corridor. Independent storefronts, restaurants and personal services occupy smaller street-facing formats, unlike the larger mixed-use buildings in The Gulch or Downtown.
whatStandsOut: Neighborhood shops and dining along 12th Avenue

industrial.label: Airport / Elm Hill
industrial.oneLineDistinction: Warehouse and service space near the airport employment area
industrial.shortDescription: Airport and Elm Hill industrial areas support warehouse, service and light-operating uses east of central Nashville near the airport employment geography. The label is not a metro-wide airport claim, and exact building access or logistics performance remains property-specific.

industrial.label: MetroCenter
industrial.oneLineDistinction: Office and flex campuses north of Downtown
industrial.shortDescription: MetroCenter groups offices, service businesses and flexible operating space in a planned employment area north of Downtown along the Cumberland River. Its campus and business-park formats differ from Downtown towers and the specialized creative buildings around Music Row.
